title: The Duel
subjects: Russia -- Social life and customs -- Fiction
blurb: Two men who cannot stand each other, a town that watches, and a duel nobody quite wants. Chekhov's longest novella, and his coldest.

rights.basis: author d. 1904; first published 1891 — public domain in India (life + 60) and the United States (pre-1930); translation by Constance Garnett (d. 1946), first published 1916 — public domain in India (life + 60) and the United States (pre-1930)

translator.name: Constance Garnett
translator.source: Wikipedia (died 17 December 1946, The Cearne, Kent), Britannica and Orlando/Cambridge all give 1861-1946; her Chekhov volumes, The Tales of Tchehov, Chatto & Windus, ran 1916-1922
